dynamic_fee_accepted.meaning: getSwapFee() accepts the dynamically calculated fee (up to MAX_FEE_CAP) rather than rejecting it

dynamic_fee_mechanism_ineffective.meaning: conflicting fee caps between DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() and CLFactory.getSwapFee() render the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective

assumptions: The dynamic fee mechanism is expected to function for fees up to MAX_FEE_CAP (500,000).

unresolved.description: The report does not state the CLFactory.getSwapFee() cap value or the numeric relation between the two caps, so the conflicting-cap mechanism cannot be encoded as a numeric comparison; only the qualitative ineffectiveness outcome is representable.

limitations: The impact is a configuration conflict rather than an executed transaction; no caller or trigger is bound.
The CLFactory.getSwapFee() cap constant is not given in the report and is left symbolic/unbound.
The ineffectiveness outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition of the conflict.
